```{r}
# extract_open_strategy.R

set.seed(4228)

pacman::p_load(tidyverse, conflicted)
conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("lag",    "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("summarise", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("mutate", "dplyr")

# -----------------------------
# Paths + files
# -----------------------------
datapath <- "data/"
DataFiles <- list.files(path = datapath, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Helper: first non-missing value (or NA)
first_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA else x[1]
}

# -----------------------------
# Extract per-subject fields
# -----------------------------
strategy_table <- purrr::map_dfr(DataFiles, function(f) {

  df <- readr::read_csv(
    f,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_guess()),
    na = c("", "NA", "null", "NaN")
  )

  # Extract subject ID from filename (same pattern you used)
  subj_id <- stringr::str_match(basename(f), "Han_curvRep1D_(\\d+)_")[, 2]

  # Safety: if regex fails, fall back to filename without extension
  if (is.na(subj_id) || subj_id == "") {
    subj_id <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  }

  # Pull one value from each column (rows all identical per your description)
  strategy_open_val <- if ("strategy_open" %in% names(df)) first_nonmissing(df$strategy_open) else NA
  art_experience_val <- if ("art_experience" %in% names(df)) first_nonmissing(df$art_experience) else NA

  tibble(
    subj_id = subj_id,
    strategy_open = strategy_open_val,
    art_experience = art_experience_val
  )
})

# If multiple files per subject exist, keep the first non-missing per subject
strategy_table <- strategy_table %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  summarise(
    strategy_open = first_nonmissing(strategy_open),
    art_experience = first_nonmissing(art_experience),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(subj_id)) %>%  # harmless if subj_id is numeric-like
  mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id))

# -----------------------------
# Write output
# -----------------------------
out_path <- file.path(getwd(), "strategy_open_art_experience_by_subject.csv")
readr::write_csv(strategy_table, out_path)

message("Wrote: ", out_path)

```

stopifnot(length(ids) == length(responses))

# ---- 3) Cluster assignment (3 clusters; keeps >= 5 per cluster) ----
# Cluster 1 = Feature-Based Analytical Comparison (default)
# Cluster 2 = Similarity Grouping & Relational Matching
# Cluster 3 = Intuitive / Salience / Minimal-report
cluster2_ids <- c(66976, 67438, 67822, 68692, 69091, 69328, 70933)
cluster3_ids <- c(67639, 68608, 69571, 70012, 67069)  # include NA as minimal-report/heuristic

strategy_df <- tibble(
  id = ids,
  response_raw = responses
) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = case_when(
      id %in% cluster2_ids ~ "Relational grouping",
      id %in% cluster3_ids ~ "Intuitive / salience",
      TRUE ~ "Feature-based analytical"
    ),
    cluster = factor(cluster, levels = c("Feature-based analytical", "Relational grouping", "Intuitive / salience"))
  )

# ---- 4) Feature-mention coding (regex dictionaries) ----
# NOTE: these are "mention" flags (not exclusive, not implying primary use)
rx_number <- "(\\bnumber\\b|\\bcount\\b|\\bcounting\\b|\\bmany\\b|\\bbump\\b|\\bbumps\\b|\\bhump\\b|\\bhumps\\b|\\blump\\b|\\blumps\\b|\\bzigzag\\b|\\bspike\\b|\\bspikes\\b|\\bcurves\\b|\\bcurve(s)?\\b)"
rx_curvature <- "(\\bcurv\\w*\\b|\\bsmooth\\w*\\b|\\bround\\w*\\b|\\bradius\\b|\\bsoft\\b|\\bjagged\\b|\\bzigzag\\b|\\bstraight\\b)"
rx_angle <- "(\\bangle\\w*\\b|\\bangular\\w*\\b|\\bslope\\w*\\b|\\bsteep\\w*\\b|\\bsharp\\w*\\b|\\bcorner\\w*\\b|\\bpoint\\w*\\b|\\btips?\\b|\\bedges?\\b|\\btriangle\\b|\\bV-shape\\b)"
rx_relational <- "(\\bleast similar\\b|\\bsimilar\\b|\\bmatch\\w*\\b|\\bmerged\\b|\\bmerge\\b|\\bcontinu\\w*\\b|\\bpart of\\b|\\bequivalen\\w*\\b|\\bprogression\\b|\\bpattern\\b|\\bstaircase\\b|\\bwhich doesn't belong\\b|\\bgroup\\w*\\b|\\bpairs?\\b)"
rx_intuition <- "(\\binstinct\\w*\\b|\\bvibes\\b|\\bstood out\\b|\\bclose my eyes\\b|\\bmy eyes\\b|\\bdrew my eyes\\b|\\bzone out\\b|\\bno strategy\\b|\\bNA\\b|\\bobvious\\b)"

strategy_df <- strategy_df %>%
  mutate(
    response_lc = str_to_lower(response_raw),
    mention_number     = as.integer(str_detect(response_lc, rx_number)),
    mention_curvature  = as.integer(str_detect(response_lc, rx_curvature)),
    mention_angle      = as.integer(str_detect(response_lc, rx_angle)),
    mention_relational = as.integer(str_detect(response_lc, rx_relational)),
    mention_intuition  = as.integer(str_detect(response_lc, rx_intuition))
  ) %>%
  select(-response_lc)

# ---- 5) Quick sanity checks ----
message("Cluster sizes:")
print(table(strategy_df$cluster))

message("Feature mention rates:")
print(colMeans(strategy_df %>% select(starts_with("mention_"))))

# ---- 6) Write out ----
out_file <- "strategy_participant_level.csv"
write_csv(strategy_df, out_file)
message("Wrote: ", out_file)
